mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.5% for two consecutive months, it signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates collapsing consumer demand, which triggers equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production (INDPRO) contractions below 90, manufacturing sector weakness signals imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of INDPRO < 90 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that forces monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly additions signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of PAYEMS > 100,000 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates severe economic contraction, triggering equity market declines and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In near-zero interest rate environments (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%), the Federal Reserve's commitment to accommodative policy supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03.
